input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4(b) requires Customer to pay uncapped "early termination charges" set out in Attachment A/Service Option Attachments as a condition of terminating for convenience — a Customer-payable liquidated amount of unknown size, with no stated ceiling (and Section 10 further preserves IBM's ability to claim amounts for Services "that would have been rendered but for Customer's breach"). Our preferred position is no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer; because the convenience-termination right is the counterweight to this charge, we applied the accepted fallback and capped the charge at three months' recurring charges as the sole amount due on such termination. No service credits or Vendor-payable LDs are affected.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' recurring charges for the terminated Services and will be Customer's sole payment obligation and IBM's sole remedy arising from such termination.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by us, so we have capped the open-ended early termination charges at three months' recurring charges as the sole amount due on a convenience termination. This keeps our termination right meaningful while accepting the accepted fallback cap rather than deleting the charge entirely.
proposal.summary: Cap Customer's early termination charges at three months' recurring charges as the sole termination amount.
